channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: High school dropout becomes Europe's richest self-made 25-year-old
item.description: James Dacombe, founder of AI chipmaker Olix and brain monitoring startup CoMind, credits his youth and naivety for his success.

item.title: Iran shifts to offensive stance, warns of attack if U.S. fails to implement ceasefire
item.description: An Iranian official stated that unless the U.S. implements the June ceasefire deal soon, Iran will launch a precise attack to break the blockade.

item.title: Low U.S. oil reserves threaten integrity of underground salt caverns
item.description: Experts warn that crude inventories below 300 million barrels could damage the structural integrity of the caverns used for storage.

item.title: JP Morgan nears $1 trillion market value, reflecting 'Jamie premium'
item.description: CEO Jamie Dimon's two-decade leadership has made JP Morgan a Wall Street powerhouse, with market cap growing from $138 billion.
